states.entry: own trajectory We; includes persistent past additional-layer repairs
states.anchor: WN = full native local-z4 write at We
states.fallback: exact WN; retain all historical repairs
states.L4_preserving_scope: within batch anchor bytes; not identical W4 across independent lifelong chains

capsule.preservation_teacher: fixed W0 Teacher192; verify same model/token binding
capsule.teacher_regeneration: only if identity/effective distribution check requires it; no generation performed by this design

data.Past64: received latest active fact; excludes current overwrites; hash priority; no success filtering
data.Past_prompt_scope: canonical rewrite only; no paraphrase expansion
data.native_context_policy: keep existing native writer contexts; do not create a paraphrase guard set

quality.mean_NLL_ceiling: each panel own WN mean + epsilon_L

gradients: Past canonical mean NLL if nonempty
direction_space.orthonormalization: FP64 Gram/QR; preserve resolved gradient span; drop numerical zero/dependency
direction_space.direction_scope_failure: not intrinsic capacity failure of the selected layer

response_model.guard_Jacobian: mean-NLL and successful context target margin/pair margin scalars
response_model.successful_margin_slack: native nonnegative token margin (argmax tie allowed); strictly positive pair-NLL preference margin
response_model.full_vocab_streaming: per document; never materialize all documents x vocab x directions
response_model.damping: minimum nonnegative shift giving condition cap; technical regularization
response_model.QP: min (R^T b)^T u + ||u||^2/2 subject A R u <= s and box radius r

controller.initial_radius: sqrt(2*B(WN)/m); numerical local scale, not capacity budget
controller.accept: first finite quality-feasible candidate with predicted>epsilon_B, actual>epsilon_B, actual/predicted>=0.1
controller.rollback_anchor: exact WN for each rejected probe

plans.technical_pilot: same W0-start N4 anchors B1/B5/B10; six repair layers each; no model run yet
plans.main: conditional five-arm W0 B100x10 after layer and solver policy lock
plans.later: locked W0 to fixed10k; no automatic submission
plans.claim_scope: same fixed-stream observations; paired uncertainty, not universal noninferiority proof

cost_upper_structure.scope: single selected-layer legacy box template; excludes layer-feasibility diagnostic

claims_excluded: newness of role split or projected gradient alone
